US Seeks Extradition of Lawrence Bishnoi from India

The United States has confirmed its intention to seek the extradition of Lawrence Bishnoi from India. The development raises questions about the legal process and potential next steps in the case. Bishnoi is a figure of interest in relation to potential US legal proceedings.
